verses.text: Therefore I, the prisoner of the Lord, implore you to walk in a manner worthy of the calling with which you have been called,
verses.textZh: 我為主被囚的勸你們：既然蒙召，行事為人就當與蒙召的恩相稱。

verses.text: with all humility and gentleness, with patience, showing tolerance for one another in love,
verses.textZh: 凡事謙虛、溫柔、忍耐，用愛心互相寬容，

verses.text: being diligent to preserve the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.textZh: 用和平彼此聯絡，竭力保守聖靈所賜合而為一的心。

verses.text: [There is] one body and one Spirit, just as also you were called in one hope of your calling;
verses.textZh: 身體只有一個，聖靈只有一個，正如你們蒙召同有一個指望。

verses.text: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
verses.textZh: 一主，一信，一洗，

verses.text: one God and Father of all who is over all and through all and in all.
verses.textZh: 一神，就是眾人的父，超乎眾人之上，貫乎眾人之中，也住在眾人之內。

verses.text: But to each one of us grace was given according to the measure of Christ's gift.
verses.textZh: 我們各人蒙恩，都是照基督所量給各人的恩賜。

verses.text: Therefore it says, 'WHEN HE ASCENDED ON HIGH, HE LED CAPTIVE A HOST OF CAPTIVES, AND HE GAVE GIFTS TO MEN.'
verses.textZh: 所以經上說：他升上高天的時候，擄掠了仇敵，將各樣的恩賜賞給人。

verses.text: (Now this [expression], 'He ascended,' what does it mean except that He also had descended into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.textZh: （既說升上，豈不是先降在地下麼？

verses.text: He who descended is Himself also He who ascended far above all the heavens, so that He might fill all things.)
verses.textZh: 那降下的，就是遠升諸天之上要充滿萬有的。）

verses.text: And He gave some [as] apostles, and some [as] prophets, and some [as] evangelists, and some [as] pastors and teachers,
verses.textZh: 他所賜的，有使徒，有先知，有傳福音的，有牧師和教師，

verses.text: for the equipping of the saints for the work of service, to the building up of the body of Christ;
verses.textZh: 為要成全聖徒，各盡其職，建立基督的身體，

verses.text: until we all attain to the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a mature man, to the measure of the stature which belongs to the fullness of Christ.
verses.textZh: 直等到我們眾人在真道上同歸於一，認識神的兒子，得以長大成人，滿有基督長成的身量，

verses.text: As a result, we are no longer to be children, tossed here and there by waves and carried about by every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, by craftiness in deceitful scheming;
verses.textZh: 使我們不再作小孩子，中了人的詭計和欺騙的法術，被一切異教之風搖動，飄來飄去，就隨從各樣的異端；

verses.text: but speaking the truth in love, we are to grow up in all [aspects] into Him who is the head, [even] Christ,
verses.textZh: 惟用愛心說誠實話，凡事長進，連於元首基督，

verses.text: from whom the whole body, being fitted and held together by what every joint supplies, according to the proper working of each individual part, causes the growth of the body for the building up of itself in love.
verses.textZh: 全身都靠他聯絡得合式，百節各按各職，照著各體的功用彼此相助，便叫身體漸漸增長，在愛中建立自己。

verses.text: So this I say, and affirm together with the Lord, that you walk no longer just as the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
verses.textZh: 所以我說，且在主裡確實的說，你們行事不要再像外邦人存虛妄的心行事。

verses.text: being darkened in their understanding, excluded from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardness of their heart;
verses.textZh: 他們心地昏昧，與神所賜的生命隔絕了，都因自己無知，心裡剛硬；

verses.text: and they, having become callous, have given themselves over to sensuality for the practice of every kind of impurity with greediness.
verses.textZh: 良心既然喪盡，就放縱私慾，貪行種種的污穢。

verses.text: But you did not learn Christ in this way,
verses.textZh: 你們學了基督，卻不是這樣。

verses.text: if indeed you have heard Him and have been taught in Him, just as truth is in Jesus,
verses.textZh: 如果你們聽過他的道，領了他的教，學了他的真理，

verses.text: that, in reference to your former manner of life, you lay aside the old self, which is being corrupted in accordance with the lusts of deceit,
verses.textZh: 就要脫去你們從前行為上的舊人，這舊人是因私慾的迷惑漸漸變壞的；

verses.text: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
verses.textZh: 又要將你們的心志改換一新，

verses.text: and put on the new self, which in [the likeness of] God has been created in righteousness and holiness of the truth.
verses.textZh: 並且穿上新人；這新人是照著神的形像造的，有真理的仁義和聖潔。

verses.text: Therefore, laying aside falsehood, SPEAK TRUTH EACH ONE [of you] WITH HIS NEIGHBOR, for we are members of one another.
verses.textZh: 所以你們要棄絕謊言，各人與鄰舍說實話，因為我們是互相為肢體。

verses.text: BE ANGRY, AND [yet] DO NOT SIN; do not let the sun go down on your anger,
verses.textZh: 生氣卻不要犯罪；不可含怒到日落，

verses.text: and do not give the devil an opportunity.
verses.textZh: 也不可給魔鬼留地步。

verses.text: He who steals must steal no longer; but rather he must labor, performing with his own hands what is good, so that he will have [something] to share with one who has need.
verses.textZh: 從前偷竊的，不要再偷；總要勞力，親手做正經事，就可有餘分給那缺少的人。

verses.text: Let no unwholesome word proceed from your mouth, but only such [a word] as is good for edification according to the need [of the moment], so that it will give grace to those who hear.
verses.textZh: 污穢的言語一句不可出口，只要隨事說造就人的好話，叫聽見的人得益處。

verses.text: Do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
verses.textZh: 不要叫神的聖靈擔憂；你們原是受了他的印記，等候得贖的日子來到。

verses.text: Let all bitterness and wrath and anger and clamor and slander be put away from you, along with all malice.
verses.textZh: 一切苦毒、惱恨、忿怒、嚷鬧、毀謗，並一切的惡毒（或作：陰毒），都當從你們中間除掉；

verses.text: Be kind to one another, tender-hearted, forgiving each other, just as God in Christ also has forgiven you.
verses.textZh: 並要以恩慈相待，存憐憫的心，彼此饒恕，正如神在基督裡饒恕了你們一樣。
